'''peterhelm Dark side Dark Deal deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[peterhelm]]
* '''Published:''' 17 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Deal peterhelm DS 2003 Darkside.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I just collected enough cards to built me a TDIGWATT Deck, Let me what you think!
